content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**Change made in response to the verifier:** added a second replace operation narrowing proviso (b), deleting "corporate reorganization" and clause (ii) (the consent-free transfer "to any entity which is a successor to the assets or the business of the M&I Data Services division of M&I"). Proviso (b) now reads: "M&I may freely assign this Agreement to a successor in connection with a merger or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities." That closes the two consent-free non-successor routes, so "Other assignments require consent." is now met in operative language rather than merely by the retained opening gate.

**Final fallback coverage:**
- Both parties may assign to a successor — op 1 (Customer's symmetrical successor carve-out; M&I's successor route retained in narrowed (b)).
- A successor assignment requires written notice — op 3 (single mutual notice sentence, tracking existing (a)/(b) lettering).
- Other assignments require consent — op 2 (removal of the reorganization and divisional-transfer exceptions).
- Consent not unreasonably withheld — already met: "which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld".

Minimality and rendering validated `ok:true`; the Section 21.11 compliance condition, the consent gate, the reasonableness standard and §21.11.B change-of-control mechanics are all preserved, with no dangling cross-reference.
